pinned_function_sha256._rule: sha256 of the utf-8 source text of each function (ast.get_source_segment of the file, LF). A mismatch means the runtime semantics this contract compares changed: re-draft before Integration relies on it. The seven candidate functions equal the signed family contract pins.

file_sha256_at_citation_base._rule: informational: whole-file sha256 at 2204e35 (master moves; the function pins above are the binding check)

signed_contracts._rule: sha256 of the committed bytes at 2204e35 (LF)

c_f02_must_stay_off.rule: family OQ4: C-F01 only. C-F02 stays OFF for the whole canary.
c_f02_must_stay_off.check: the settings SLEEVES entry with id "C-F02" has enabled == false (or is absent) at preflight, at every canary cycle and at the end; C-F02 has 0 lots, 0 working entries and 0 history rows opened during the canary (P13). Default: engine.CANDIDATE_DEFAULT_ENABLED is False.
c_f02_must_stay_off.on_violation: stop condition S2 (a MUST-MATCH divergence: P13)

replay_definition.semantics: the SIGNED repro contract semantics block, keys cited per field (frame_and_warmup, indicators, entry_signal, signal_exit, pending_and_fill, sizing, per_bar_management_order, intrabar_path, time_exit, exit_accounting, stats), F01 cell only
replay_definition.input_frames: the exact closed 4h candles the runtime computed its signals from, per symbol (recorded with sha256 in the evidence frames_manifest), never a separately downloaded series
replay_definition.account: the replay keeps its own single-cell account ($500, share 1.0, 1 %, 10x, 8 % halt) so its trade list is self-contained; absolute size fields are NOT-COMPARABLE (P15)
replay_definition.executor: Evidence lane (Cowork) independent harness, no import of Build runtime modules (the repro forbidden list applies); Build does not compute verdicts (OQ7)
replay_definition.trade_set_rule: the runtime and replay trade sets on (symbol, entry bar, side) must match, EXCEPT entries the runtime refused for a logged NOT-COMPARABLE / MEASURED-DIFF reason (P08-P11) and the replay trades that follow from that divergence on the same symbol; every exception is listed. An unexplained missing or extra trade is a MUST-MATCH failure (OQ4).

parity_fields.definition: open time (UTC) of the closed 4h candle a C-F01 decision is taken on
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.compute_signals (al[s].iloc[-1] -> sg["time"]), engine.py:Engine.cycle
parity_fields.comparison_rule: per (symbol, decision bar): the runtime decision bar equals the replay decision bar; a closed bar the replay decides on with no runtime decision is a gap

parity_fields.definition: long entry signal value on the decision bar (xup(e20,e50) and c>e200 and ret42>0 and ret180>0)
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.compute_signals (S.signals -> raw["le"][-1], masked by sides "long"), strategies.py:sig_ema_mom, strategies.py:xup
parity_fields.comparison_rule: the replay runs on the SAME closed-candle frame the runtime used (frames_manifest sha256 per symbol); boolean equality per (symbol, decision bar)
parity_fields.legitimate_difference: an EMA200 / ret180 seeded on a different history length can flip a marginal cross; that is why the replay must run on the runtime frame (OQ2), never on a separately downloaded series

parity_fields.definition: long exit signal value on each managed bar: (e20<e50) or not (ret42>0 and ret180>0)
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.compute_signals (raw["lx"][-1]), strategies.py:sig_ema_mom
parity_fields.comparison_rule: same frame; boolean equality per (symbol, bar) for every bar a C-F01 lot is open

parity_fields.definition: ATR(14, Wilder ewm alpha 1/14) of the decision bar, the stop-distance input
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:_sig_atr (ema_mom supplies no own atr -> d.atr), strategies.py:indicators
parity_fields.replay_source: semantics.indicators.atr, semantics.sizing (ATR[i] of the decision bar)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: same frame; |runtime - replay| / replay

parity_fields.definition: count of long entry signals on the 18 symbols over the canary decision bars, before any refusal
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.cycle (every sg with le: opened, or logged via miss / _audit_cand)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: integer equality

parity_fields.definition: a signal on a coin C-F01 already holds is dropped (not queued)
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.cycle ("already in a trade on this coin"; with C-F02 OFF the same-slot claim falls through engine.py:Engine.candidate_block)
parity_fields.replay_source: semantics.pending_and_fill (a signal on a held symbol is dropped)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: the same (symbol, decision bar) set is refused for this reason

parity_fields.definition: a signal refused because 4 family claims are open (the per-slot max_pos 4 and the shared family cap 4 coincide while C-F02 is OFF)
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.candidate_block ("candidate family trend_long: <n> open (one shared cap of 4)"), engine.py:Engine.cycle ("max positions reached (4)")
parity_fields.replay_source: semantics.pending_and_fill (4 open -> remaining pending discarded, fixed-18 order)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: the same (symbol, decision bar) set is refused for a cap reason; either cap text counts (candidate_block is the earlier gate)
parity_fields.legitimate_difference: runtime claims also count working entries (unconfirmed / deferred); with ENTRY_ORDER market they live for seconds. A cap refusal caused by a working entry is reported as MEASURED-DIFF with the claim listed

parity_fields.definition: a signal refused because ANOTHER slot (rotation / scalp / other candidate) claims the coin
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.candidate_block ("candidate isolation: slot <owner> holds this coin"), engine.py:Engine._claims
parity_fields.replay_source: none: the replay is a single-cell book (semantics.pending_and_fill has no other slots)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: count and list each refusal with its owner; the owner must never be C-F02 (C-F02 OFF)

tolerance.note: not compared; counted and listed with its reason

parity_fields.legitimate_difference: the account runs other PAPER slots the replay does not model

parity_fields.definition: a signal refused by the daily loss halt
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.cycle ("daily loss halt"), engine.py:Engine.entry_block ("daily loss halt is active")
parity_fields.replay_source: semantics.per_bar_management_order step 5 (8 % Cairo-day halt on the replay account)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: list both sides' halt windows; a runtime halt is account-wide (all slots), the replay halt is C-F01-only

tolerance.note: no pass/fail bound; the measured delta is reported per trade and in aggregate

parity_fields.legitimate_difference: different equity base (the whole PAPER account vs a single $500 cell)

parity_fields.definition: refusals that exist only at runtime: exchange rules (step / minQty / minNotional / max qty), leverage cap, outage, persist_block, stop_missing_block, untracked / unconfirmed claims, control factor, fee-edge gate, AI filter, order failure, ORDER-SYM-01 cost_pending deferral
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.entry_block, engine.py:Engine.open_lot, feasibility.py:size_check, engine.py:Engine._market_entry, engine.py:Engine.cycle (_defer)
parity_fields.replay_source: semantics.sizing (legacy floor only) - the replay has none of these

parity_fields.legitimate_difference: exchange truth and operational gates; each one explains a missing trade but must be listed

parity_fields.definition: replay skip: qty x fill below the legacy min notional (50 BTC / 20 ETH, LINK / 5 others)
parity_fields.runtime_source: none (the runtime uses exchange rules, P10)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: list each replay floor skip

tolerance.note: not compared; counted and listed with its reason

parity_fields.legitimate_difference: legacy research floor vs live exchange filters

parity_fields.definition: number of open C-F01 lots at each decision bar (after the bar's exits)
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.cycle (held list per slot), engine.py:Engine._claims
parity_fields.comparison_rule: integer equality at every decision bar while the trade sets agree

parity_fields.definition: C-F02 lots, working entries, history rows and claims during the canary

parity_fields.comparison_rule: exactly 0 of each

parity_fields.definition: risk_usd / the sleeve equity basis (equity x 1/6) of each C-F01 entry
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.open_lot (sleeve_eq = eq * sl["share"]; risk = sl["risk"] * kelly_mult * governor_mult; x ctrl factor)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: runtime risk_usd equals eq x 1/6 x 0.01; the lot risk_usd is rounded to cents
parity_fields.legitimate_difference: requires kelly_mult = governor_mult = ctrl long_factor = 1.0 (canary preconditions C6-C7)

parity_fields.definition: absolute risk_usd, qty and notional of an entry
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.open_lot (eq x CANDIDATE_SHARE 1/6)
parity_fields.replay_source: semantics.sizing (realized cash equity of a $500 single-cell account, share 1.0)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: reported side by side; never pass/fail

tolerance.note: not compared; counted and listed with its reason

parity_fields.legitimate_difference: different account and share basis (1/6 of PAPER equity vs a whole $500 cell)

parity_fields.definition: R_dist = 2.5 x ATR of the decision bar
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.open_lot (F.risk_qty with mgmt stop_atr 2.5 -> plan stop_dist), feasibility.py:risk_qty
parity_fields.comparison_rule: |runtime stop_dist - 2.5 x replay ATR[i]| / (2.5 x replay ATR[i])

parity_fields.definition: risk-sized qty before the leverage cap and step floor = risk_usd / R_dist
parity_fields.runtime_source: feasibility.py:risk_qty, feasibility.py:size_check
parity_fields.comparison_rule: recompute from the runtime's own risk_usd and R_dist; the sent qty is that value floored to the exchange step (never rounded up)

tolerance.unit: exchange step of the symbol (floor only)

parity_fields.definition: qty capped so the slot notional <= MAX_LEVERAGE (10) x sleeve equity
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.open_lot (lev_room over the slot's lots at avg, / mark px), feasibility.py:size_check
parity_fields.replay_source: semantics.sizing ((10 x sl_eq - sum(open qty x close[fill-1])) / fill price)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: list every entry where either side binds; report the qty delta

tolerance.note: no pass/fail bound; the measured delta is reported per trade and in aggregate

parity_fields.legitimate_difference: different equity basis and price reference (mark at decision vs previous close)

parity_fields.definition: initial exchange stop = measured entry fill - R_dist, rounded to the tick
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine._create_lot (stop = _rd(fill - sd * stop_dist, tick))
parity_fields.comparison_rule: runtime stop vs round_tick(runtime measured fill - 2.5 x replay ATR[i]): the replay rule applied to the runtime fill
parity_fields.legitimate_difference: the absolute stop vs the replay stop differs by the fill-price difference (P21)

parity_fields.definition: effective mgmt of C-F01 = {stop_atr: 2.5}; no breakeven, trail, tp, partial, pyramid, DCA, runner or time exit; the stop never moves
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine.mgmt -> strategies.py:merge_mgmt("ema_mom", {}), engine.py:candidate_sleeves (mgmt {})
parity_fields.replay_source: semantics.intrabar_path (no breakeven / trail / partial / pyramid / DCA), semantics.time_exit (F01 has none)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: exact mgmt dict; every recorded stop level of a lot equals its initial stop

parity_fields.definition: entry fill price
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine._market_entry (avgPrice of the market order, measured)
parity_fields.comparison_rule: report (runtime - replay) / replay in bps per trade and the mean

tolerance.note: no pass/fail bound; the measured delta is reported per trade and in aggregate

parity_fields.legitimate_difference: a market order sent seconds after the candle close vs the modelled next-bar open plus 2 bp

parity_fields.definition: bar in which the entry fills
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine._create_lot (lot opened)

parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine._finish (exit = qty-weighted close fills, measured)

parity_fields.legitimate_difference: stop-market slippage and market close vs the modelled level minus 2 bp

parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine._finish (r = net / risk_usd), actual_costs.py (AC.row_view measured)

tolerance.note: no pass/fail bound; the measured delta is reported per trade and in aggregate

parity_fields.legitimate_difference: fills and costs are measured at runtime and modelled in the replay

parity_fields.definition: entry + exit commission
parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine._cost_final, actual_costs.py (measured commission per fill)

tolerance.note: no pass/fail bound; the measured delta is reported per trade and in aggregate

parity_fields.runtime_source: engine.py:Engine._cost_final, actual_costs.py (measured funding)

parity_class_rules.MUST-MATCH: outside tolerance = PARITY-FAIL and canary stop condition S2
parity_class_rules.MEASURED-DIFF: reported with per-trade and aggregate deltas; never pass/fail; Integration reads them
parity_class_rules.NOT-COMPARABLE: counted and listed with the reason; never silently dropped

failure_injections.name: restart mid-position
failure_injections.inject: open a C-F01 lot through the cycle, persist settings + state, construct a new Engine on the same data dir with the same exchange (stop still resting)
failure_injections.expected: the lot reloads with its sleeve, stop and stop id unchanged; a same-coin signal is refused "already in a trade on this coin"; the next lx=True cycle closes it as exit_signal; C-F02 stays OFF

failure_injections.name: pending-cost row older than 6 h
failure_injections.inject: a C-F01 closed row whose costs stay pending; guard at close + 21599 s and + 21600 s (C-F02 OFF)
failure_injections.expected: no disable before 6 h; at 6 h candidate_guard switches C-F01 off with "accounting: ..."; C-F02 stays OFF and is not reported; open lots keep stop and management

failure_injections.name: evicted pending row behind > 3000 closes + restart
failure_injections.inject: a real C-F01 close with pending costs, 3000 newer rows, one more real close (eviction), save, restart
failure_injections.expected: the durable index still holds the row; the guard disables the family at close + 6 h on the stored close time; only settlement clears it

failure_injections.name: lost protection (restoring / owner_check)
failure_injections.inject: an open C-F01 lot gets stop_miss with stop_miss_why checking, then restoring / owner_check
failure_injections.expected: checking: no disable; restoring / owner_check: C-F01 switched off ("protection: <sym> stop <why>"); the guard never closes the lot, its stop stays, and it is still exited by its signal

failure_injections.name: family disable: drift / family order / symbol order / guard error
failure_injections.inject: card drift on any CANDIDATE_CARD field; both members enabled out of order; a reordered CAND_FIXED18; an exception inside the guard
failure_injections.expected: every enabled member switched off in the same pass with the named reason; only Integration re-enables; the disabled state survives a restart

canary.authorization_rule: execution needs a separate Integration (Codex) comment id recorded here by Integration; this contract alone authorizes nothing
canary.environment: PAPER / Binance Futures testnet only; never mainnet, never MODE / LIVE_CONFIRM changes

preconditions.rule: flat start: no C-F01 or C-F02 lot, pending, resting, unconfirmed or deferred entry; OR an explicitly reconciled start whose open C-F01 lots are listed (symbol, opened, stop) in preflight.json and accepted by Integration (OQ3)
candidate_guard green: no drift / protection / accounting / order trigger for C-F01; state["candidate_disabled"] has no unresolved C-F01 entry, or Integration cleared it
the C-F01 slot equals its frozen card (candidate_drift == [])
GOVERNOR mode off (governor_mult == 1.0) and C-F01 has no kelly block (kelly_mult == 1.0)
ctrl long_factor == 1.0 (CTRL_BIAS neutral or bearish, CTRL_RISK max_test)
ENTRY_ORDER market, AI_FILTER false, FEE_EDGE_GATE false, MAX_LEVERAGE 10 (or Integration records other values, OQ5)
the pinned function sha256s of this contract equal the running build; the running head SHA is recorded
the Integration authorization comment id is recorded in canary.authorization_comment_id

bounds_proposed.risk_per_trade: 1 % of the 1/6 share (frozen card; not changed for the canary)
bounds_proposed.drawdown_bound_note: cumulative measured C-F01 net R from the canary peak; the packet max DD is 7.55 R over about 23.5 months

stop_conditions.rule: candidate_guard disables C-F01 for any reason (drift, protection, accounting, family order, guard_error)
any MUST-MATCH parity field outside tolerance (including P13 C-F02 activity)
a C-F01 lot loses protection: stop_miss_why restoring or owner_check (also S1)
a C-F01 closed row has costs pending >= 21600 s (also S1)
cumulative measured C-F01 drawdown reaches the Integration-set bound (proposed 4 R)
the duration or closed-trade bound is reached (normal end)
any mainnet / live / credential event, MODE change, or an environment that cannot be confirmed as testnet

rollback: R1 Integration (only) sets the C-F01 slot enabled = false through settings; Build and Evidence never edit settings
R2 open C-F01 lots are NOT closed by the rollback: they keep their exchange stop and management (signal exit) until they exit on their own, unless Integration separately orders a close (OQ8)
R3 confirm after the next cycle: no new C-F01 entry, every open C-F01 lot has a confirmed stop (no stop_miss), C-F02 still OFF
R4 publish the evidence bundle with the stop condition id and the final verdict; record the candidate_disabled reason if the guard fired

Confirm the Evidence lane (Cowork) runs the independent replay and the verdict, and Build only supplies the runtime extracts (decisions / trades / frames manifest) with no verdict.
